problem_type: Asset folders cannot be moved or searched consistently and invalid JSON imports as an empty scene
symptom: Asset folders cannot be moved or searched consistently and invalid JSON imports as an empty scene
direct_cause: The UI had no directory move path and filtering hid matching descendants under folded parents; permissive scene normalization accepted unrelated JSON.
class_root: Asset hierarchy mutations and scene import did not enforce referential validity and schema identity at their shared boundaries.
affected_population: All director sessions using the affected user and stored-data entry points
entry_points: Read all asset CRUD and upload/linked add handlers
Read folder tree filtering and folded rendering
Read normalizeScene permissive record normalization and AI groups schema
internal_only_reason: This is internal director request and asset ownership; no third-party behavior determines the invariant.
invariants: A directory cannot become its own ancestor.
Uploads completing after target deletion remain reachable at root.
Search hits remain visible through their ancestor path.
Unrelated JSON cannot create a successful empty import.
generality_proof: All equivalent producers converge on the same action or request boundary, which validates ownership before mutating project state.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject cyclic targets and retain ancestor paths of search hits.
Validate current folder targets and distinguish AI-scene JSON from director scene records before import.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Tests reject self/descendant moves, preserve upload after parent deletion, and import AI groups while rejecting unrelated JSON.
Unit search-ancestor test plus real menu/drop/cycle/search journey in director-assets.walk.mjs.

recurrence.reason: Any user may repeat these event and input sequences.
same_class_scan: Read all asset CRUD and upload/linked add handlers
Read folder tree filtering and folded rendering
Read normalizeScene permissive record normalization and AI groups schema

prevention.invariant: Mutations preserve valid folder destinations and imports carry a recognized scene shape.
prevention.failure_mode: Reject invalid input without mutating project; cancelled work cannot publish.
prevention.strategy: Use one ancestor-chain validator for menu and drag entry points; validate upload destination at commit; parse AI groups before the director-scene schema boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the permissive mutation paths in place without parallel fallbacks.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Application-owned event ordering and input invariants use existing APIs.

migration: No schema bump; valid stored folder identities are retained. New mutations use the shared ancestor-chain validator.
residual_risks: Previously persisted externally corrupted cyclic folder data is not migrated by this patch; new move operations reject loops.
Deleting asset entries deliberately removes project references, not shared cached files.
Splat decoding and reveal are verified with the current Spark renderer through the uploaded PLY valley walkthrough.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/model/storeAssetActions.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
